description: Changes ONE existing wording of a webinar without rebuilding anything: a block on the page, text inside the page's raw code, the campaign copy (landing, sales copy, headlines, mail subjects and bodies) or the visible page heading. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site and participants see it at once; no text is generated and nothing else on the campaign is touched. Needs `session_id` and `webinar_id` from wi_list_webinars. `find` is the current wording copied word for word from the site, `value` the new one, and `target` says where it stands: page_block (one block, find = its whole visible text), page_code (text inside the page code), journey_field (the campaign copy) or page_heading (the page title, find is ignored). `surface` picks the page: registration (default), thankyou or webinar. `all` changes every exact hit outside shortcodes and applies to page_code only; leave it out to change exactly one spot. When the wording stands several times the site refuses with code ambiguous instead of guessing, and when it stands nowhere it answers not_found. Report it as done only when the answer carries changed true, and relay a refusal word for word.

all.description: page_code only: true replaces every exact hit outside shortcodes. Leave it out to change exactly one spot.

confirm.description: Only after the site answered code admin_editing: the host agreed to overwrite unsaved changes in wp-admin.

find.description: The current wording, copied word for word from the site. Left out only for target page_heading.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

surface.description: Which page the target belongs to. Default registration.

target.description: Where the wording stands. One target per call.

value.description: The new wording, taken verbatim. Needed for every target.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_text
title: Change one text of a webinar
